title: R5b — vwf over stackgen bundles: architecture composes, setup adds tools and addons through bootstrap, doctor examines the links

keeps.check: grep -rnE over plugins/vwf/ for: language_facts|optional_languages|lsp_servers|bootstrap add plugin|\.claude/skills/design-import
keeps.pass: No hit, except a passage that names an earlier format as history (R4b D23) and the lock key local_plugin.lsp_servers (R5a D41). Each such hit is listed with its reason in the run report.

release_levels.reason: The design wrappers call vwf-tools with the project name; setup adds bundle tools and declares addons through bootstrap; doctor drops the pack-fact checks and adds the tool-link, LSP and design-tool rows.
The menu payload and the materialized entry carry the bundle tools; addons.yaml gains plugin, marketplace and repo; typescript names no vwf path.
The manual describes architecture, setup, doctor and the design adapters over bundles.

decisions.decision: Where ux-gate lives after R5.
decisions.ruling: ux-gate stays in stackgen tools/typescript as the web stack UX adapter, at its fixed name; the reviewer is unchanged. The docs/blueprint/environment.md mentions in tools/typescript become the repo environment catalog. Reverses the ux-gate part of B3 and R5a D15.
decisions.rejected: Move it to vwf as vwf:ux-gate.

decisions.decision: What stack.template names.
decisions.ruling: A bundle, shipped or a repo bundle in .claude/stackgen/bundles/ (B9); no format change.

decisions.decision: How vwf calls a design adapter.
decisions.ruling: Each wrapper calls vwf-tools:<role> with the project name first (R5a D27, D32); the repo .claude/skills copy is not read; a missing skill or reference stops with /vwf:setup.

decisions.decision: How an addon is installed (bootstrap has no add plugin verb).
decisions.ruling: Setup sets tools.claude.plugins.project.<plugin>@<marketplace> to the owner/repo of addons.yaml with bootstrap config set, unsets a dropped one, and runs mise run setup:ai. Corrects B8.

decisions.decision: How architecture decides the stack.
decisions.ruling: The menu shows bundles, repo bundles, design tools, addons and compose; compose asks tools (bootstrap catalog), packs and uncovered items, calls stackgen-stack-menu compose, and records the slug; no pick keeps unresolved.

decisions.decision: Who runs the stackgen-sync conversion of old rows.
decisions.ruling: Setup materialize, first, on consent, when lock.yaml has a pack row of a removed kind; doctor reports such a row as degraded with /vwf:setup.

decisions.decision: Who adds and links the bundle tools.
decisions.ruling: Setup materialize, before the stack-template call: bootstrap add tool for each missing tool, then bootstrap detect --add, on one consent line.

decisions.decision: The doctor checks.
decisions.ruling: Remove binaries, probes and lockfile facts; LSP matches bootstrap lsp --json; versions cover tool rows; new degraded rows for unlinked bundle tools, a missing design-tool reference in vwf-tools, an addon absent from plugins.project, and old pack rows.

decisions.decision: The split record after R5b.
decisions.ruling: The amendment background path names the -resolved gap record; B3 and B8 get the D1 and D4 corrections.

decisions.decision: Release levels.
decisions.ruling: vwf MAJOR, stackgen MINOR (D23, D24), site MINOR, installer NONE.

decisions.decision: A review unit.
decisions.ruling: Yes, U7: doctor scripts change.

decisions.decision: Execution mode.
decisions.ruling: teams: wave 1 holds seven edit units with disjoint paths.

decisions.decision: Gates and keeps.
decisions.ruling: Unit code:format; wave code:lint, vitest, p:plugins:check; plan code:precommit, vitest, p:plugins:check, p:site:check; U9 checks the marketplace and the inventory. K1 greps plugins/vwf for removed pack data names.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 1: the four wrapper SKILL.md files name the repo skill; no unit owned them.
decisions.ruling: They join U5's owns and name vwf-tools:<role> with the fix /vwf:setup.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 2: addons.yaml has one source field; setup needs a marketplace name and an owner/repo.
decisions.ruling: U6 owns plugins/stackgen/assets/addons.yaml; each entry has name, summary, plugin, marketplace, repo and design_tools; source goes.
decisions.rejected: Derive the marketplace from the repo name.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 3: config set tools.claude.* exits 2 when claude is not selected.
decisions.ruling: Setup adds claude with bootstrap add tool on the same consent line as the bundle tools.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 4: what a dropped addon is.
decisions.ruling: Each plugins.project key that matches an addons.yaml entry not in addons: is unset; every other key stays.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 5: detect --add links nothing in an empty project folder.
decisions.ruling: When detect proposes no link of a bundle tool to its project, setup sets tools.<t>.projects with bootstrap config set.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 6: the reworded typescript entry keeps version 1.0.0, so sync never delivers it.
decisions.ruling: U6 bumps tools/typescript/tool.yaml to 1.0.1 and regenerates stacks/inventory.md (D21).

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 7: config-and-env.md also names a bare environment.md.
decisions.ruling: Reword those mentions too.

decisions.decision: The inventory pre-commit hook watches tools/ after R5a, so U6s commit fails if U9 regenerates the inventory later (as R5a D21).
decisions.ruling: U6 owns stacks/inventory.md and regenerates it as its last step; U9 only checks.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gaps 1 and 2: Out of scope named two stackgen files; R5a's menu and asset prose describe addons.yaml source and bootstrap add plugin, and no unit owned them.
decisions.ruling: A new wave-1 unit U10 owns plugins/stackgen/skills/ and plugins/stackgen/assets/ (addons.yaml moves from U6) and rewords the addon passages; Out of scope lists the stackgen paths R5b owns.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 3: setup and doctor need a bundle's tools, and a shipped bundle lives in the stackgen plugin.
decisions.ruling: The menu payload carries each bundle's tools (setup reads them before materializing); the materialized entry .claude/stackgen/templates/<slug>.md carries the same tools in its frontmatter (doctor reads it).

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 3: doctor must map an addon name to its plugins.project key.
decisions.ruling: An addons.yaml name equals its plugin; doctor looks for a key <name>@<marketplace>.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 4: bootstrap refuses projects for a root_only tool or an unlisted project.
decisions.ruling: Setup and doctor skip root_only tools (selected is enough) and projects with no repo.projects entry (R4b D26 reports them).

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 5: config get tools.claude.* fails when claude is not selected.
decisions.ruling: Doctor reports the addon row as degraded with /vwf:setup, not a refusal.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 6: materialize.md sends addons as landing entries and removes them with a stack-template call.
decisions.ruling: Addons leave the landing list and that removal call goes; D4 and D17 replace them.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 1: stack-adapter.md keeps the old payloads and the old addon section.
decisions.ruling: U1 adds the bundle tools and the addon plugin, marketplace and repo to the payload schemas, and rewrites the addon section to plugins.project and setup:ai.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 2: neither catalog nor describe exposes root_only.
decisions.ruling: Only tools of category languages or package-managers (from describe) get project links, as bootstrap R2d D30; any other bundle tool only needs to be selected.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 3: setup:ai does not exist without the claude tool.
decisions.ruling: Run setup:ai only when claude is selected and this run set or unset a plugins.project key.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 4: doctor cannot read an addon's marketplace.
decisions.ruling: Doctor matches any plugins.project key that starts with <name>@.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 1: claude is added only with a bundle landing.
decisions.ruling: Step 4 asks its own consent to add claude when it is not selected and step 2 did not add it.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 2: a materialized entry from before R5b has no tools key.
decisions.ruling: A degraded row with the fix /vwf:setup, never a refusal and never an empty list.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 3: config set may not accept a sub-key of the plugins.project default (R1a D21).
decisions.ruling: Setup reads the plugins.project map with config get, edits it, and writes the whole map back with config set tools.claude.plugins.project '<JSON object>'; this covers the D17 unset.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 4: 'the servers the repo needs' is undefined.
decisions.ruling: Every server of data.servers of bootstrap lsp --json run in that repo, as R5a D9 copies them.
